hero.titular: Your whole club in one place, so the time goes to the pitch
hero.subtitulo: Teams, training, call-ups, matches and communication with families, on the web and on mobile. Built for club management and for its coaches.

problema.i1d: Spreadsheets, messaging groups, notebooks: every team does it its own way.
problema.i2t: Management can't see the whole picture
problema.i2d: Finding out how attendance, reports or call-ups are going across all teams takes hours.
problema.i3d: Call-ups, schedules and notices get lost among messages.

roles.titulo: What changes for each of you
roles.direccionD: The status of every team on one dashboard; seasons, teams and coaching staff; report campaigns and announcements to the whole club.
roles.coordinacionD: The teams you coordinate, their squads, their coaching staff and report follow-up.
roles.entrenadoresD: Sessions, drills, call-ups, line-ups and match data entry from your phone.
roles.familiasD: The MisterFC app, to reply to call-ups, check the calendar and follow how their son or daughter is progressing.

funciones.f1d: A drill library with diagrams, a weekly session planner and PDFs for the pitch.
funciones.f2t: Call up and pick the line-up
funciones.f2d: Publish the call-up, get the families’ replies and build the line-up by dragging players.
funciones.f3d: Goals, cards and substitutions from your phone, even offline; at full time, a rating for every player.
funciones.f4d: Goals and a report per period for every player, with a PDF for families.
funciones.f5d: Headcount, results, attendance and alerts across the whole club.
funciones.f6d: Messages, announcements and notifications inside the app, without relying on messaging groups.

seguridad.titulo: Children's data, treated as what it is
seguridad.p1: You can only join a club by invitation.
seguridad.p2: A club cannot see another club's data: access control is enforced in the database itself.
seguridad.p3: A player's photo is not shown without image consent.
seguridad.p4: Within the club, health data is only visible to those who need it, and every access by staff is logged.
seguridad.p5: Data is hosted in the European Union.
seguridad.p6: A guardian can download their child's data or request its deletion.

familias.texto: Your club will invite you to the MisterFC app: call-ups, calendar, messages and how your son or daughter is progressing.
familias.suscripcion: For families, the app works with an annual subscription purchased inside the app itself. It is per account: a single subscription covers all your children.

pasos.p3t: You invite your coaching staff and families

quien.texto: MisterFC is a product of Cognix Labs, S.L.U., based in Valencia.

faq.costeR: For the club, nothing. MisterFC is paid for by families, with an annual subscription per account purchased inside the app. Coaching staff and club management do not pay.
faq.familiasP: Do families have to pay anything?
faq.familiasR: Yes: an annual subscription per account, purchased in the app. A single subscription covers all the children on that account. Each relative who follows the player from their own account, such as grandparents, needs their own. Anyone on the coaching staff or club management does not pay, even if they are also family.
faq.instalarP: Do we need to install anything?
faq.instalarR: Club management and coaches can use the web from any browser. For day-to-day use there is an app for iOS and Android.
faq.conexionR: The mobile app lets you view information already downloaded and record match events without signal.
faq.jugadoresR: Yes, from an Excel or CSV sheet using our template.
faq.valencianoR: Yes: Spanish, Valencian and English, on the web and in the app.
faq.menoresR: Within the club, each person sees what corresponds to their role: management, coordinator, coach or family. Health data is only visible to those who need it, always with recorded consent, and every access by staff is logged.

final.titulo: We will show you MisterFC with your own club’s teams.
final.texto: One video call and we answer all your questions. Requesting it commits you to nothing.

seguridad.intro: How MisterFC handles the club's data and, above all, children's data.
seguridad.S1: You can only join a club by invitation. There is no open sign-up.
seguridad.S2: A club cannot see another club's data: access control is enforced in the database itself, table by table, not just on screen.
seguridad.S3: Every change passes more than 140 automated database security tests before it is released.
seguridad.S4: Each person sees what corresponds to their role: management, coordinator, coach or family.
seguridad.S5: Whether a player is a minor is calculated every day from their date of birth. While the player is a minor, their sensitive data (health, consents, deletion and download) is managed by their guardian; at 18 it passes to the player.
seguridad.S6: A minor cannot have their own account without a linked guardian, and the last guardian cannot unlink while the minor has one.
seguridad.S7: Separate consents (internal images, images on social media, medical data), in a record that cannot be edited or deleted: withdrawing a consent adds a new entry.
seguridad.S8: Without image consent, the player's photo is not shown. If consent is withdrawn, it stops being visible immediately, in file storage too.
seguridad.S9: Within the club, health data is only visible to club management, the coaching staff of the player's team (and of the team calling the player up, only until the end of the match day), the guardian, and the player themselves if they are an adult. Always with recorded consent.
seguridad.S10: Every access to health data by staff is logged: who, when and from where.
seguridad.S11: A guardian can download all of their child's data as a PDF and request its deletion, which the club approves.
seguridad.S12: Any user can delete their account, from the app or from the web.
seguridad.S13: Password recovery has attempt limits, and so do invitations.
seguridad.S14: On mobile, the session is stored in the system's secure storage (Keychain and Keystore).
seguridad.S15: Technical error reports do not include emails, IP addresses or cookies, and sessions are not recorded.
seguridad.S16: We do not store card details: in-app payments are processed by Apple and Google.
seguridad.S17: No third-party advertising or analytics in the app.
seguridad.S18: Providers: Supabase (database and files), Vercel (hosting), Resend (email), Sentry (errors), Expo, Apple and Google (mobile notifications) and RevenueCat (in-app subscriptions).
seguridad.S19: Data is hosted in the European Union (Ireland): the database and the files.
